purpose: Pillar B step B1: the source registry and crawl policy for official Vietnamese corporate-action evidence. Declares what may be requested, from where, how often, and what is retained. Nothing here authorizes a scheduled crawl by itself -- see approval_state.

approval_state.meaning: Owner approved declared sources. `official_source_registry.py` admits requests for approved sources according to rate, host, and document rules.
approval_state.approved_at_provenance: Owner confirmed on 2026-08-03 that they approved the registry personally and that the originally recorded 14:00 was Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh (UTC+07:00); the canonical instant is therefore 07:00Z. The earlier 2026-08-03T14:00:00Z was a local time written with a Z suffix.
approval_state.reopening_rule: Activating a source is an owner decision recorded here and in docs/DECISIONS.md.

global_policy.robots_policy: respect_robots_txt_and_terms; a Disallow on the target path is terminal for that path, never worked around
global_policy.max_redirects_enforcement: official_document_acquisition.fetch_http follows one hop at a time and admits each hop against this registry before following it; a refused hop is terminal for that request and retains nothing
global_policy.retention: immutable, content-addressed by SHA-256; documents are never overwritten, edited or deleted
global_policy.credentials: none; no source in this registry requires or accepts authentication

excluded_sources.note: Permanently out of scope. Not to be tested, called, retried, diagnosed or recommended. See docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-08-03.

sources.authority: Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange
sources.discovery_path: operator-supplied finite listing or detail URLs only; no pagination, no search, no link following. One bounded official-search-engine locator may be retained when a milestone explicitly authorizes official exchange trading-statistics discovery, including a bounded daily-trading-summary route qualification; the retained official URL and bytes, never the search snippet, are the authority.
sources.terms_considerations: Public disclosure pages. Exchange notices are published for investor use; retention is for evidence provenance, not redistribution.

sources.discovery_path: per-security event pages, operator-supplied; the design records these as the most structured source and therefore the first crawl candidate (B2)

sources.authority: Vietnam Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation
sources.index_document_type_rule: A navigation/index page is a DISCOVERY INPUT, never corporate-action evidence. It is admissible for acquisition so links can be read from a stored artifact, and is refused by official_document_store.adopt_retained_document, so it can never reach the observation ledger, the resolver, qualified_official or corroborated_period_end. Declared for vsdc only, because vsdc is the one source whose index pages are observed in a retained first-party artifact (the /en/alc/6 breadcrumb in the retained VNM notice /en/ad/177392). Do not add this type to another source without the same kind of observation.
sources.discovery_path: operator-supplied finite notice URLs only, plus the announcement index pages named in index_document_types; no pagination, no search, no link following beyond one parsed index page
sources.terms_considerations: Public registration notices. VSDC is the authority for record dates and entitlement execution method.

sources.host_admission_rule: An issuer host is admitted only when retained official evidence, or a bounded issuer IR page that directly links the exact filing, evidences it. `storage.thepangroup.vn` is the existing retained PAN FY2024 filing host. PNJ's official financial-reports page directly links `cdn.pnj.io` FY2024 consolidated statements; FPT's official IR report page and attempted FY2024 issuer filing are on `fpt.com`; PV Drilling's official financial-statements page lists its FY2024 audited consolidated statement on `www.pvdrilling.com.vn`; QNS's official FY2024 report directly publishes the audited consolidated financial-statement section on `www.qns.com.vn`; PV Power's official FY2024 financial-statements page directly links its audited consolidated statement on `pvpower.vn`; Novaland's official IR financial-statements page directly links its FY2024 audited consolidated filing on `www.novaland.com.vn`; PV GAS's official IR shareholder-documents page lists its FY2024 audited consolidated financial statements on `www.pvgas.com.vn`; Vincom Retail's official IR portal publishes its FY2025 audited consolidated financial statements directly on `ir.vincom.com.vn`. This is an enumerated evidence relationship, not a wildcard for cloud/CDN hosts; see docs/annual_financial_source_authority_decision.md, the 2026-08-09 scale-out decisions, and the P2-D2 promotion decision.
sources.discovery_path: operator-supplied finite URLs only; issuer sites are not crawled
